$comment: The catalogues this repository generates. Read by eng/CatalogGen (--manifest) and by
the scheduled workflow in .github/workflows/nightly-catalogs.yml, so the list lives
here as data rather than being duplicated in CI configuration.
output paths are relative to this file.
version defaults to "latest", which resolves to the latest *stable* release.
StyleCop.Analyzers' latest STABLE is 1.1.118, published in April 2019; the project has
lived on 1.2.0-beta ever since, and that is what projects actually install. Mirroring the
stable therefore mirrored a release almost nobody runs — and one rule already disagreed:
SA1413's category differs between the two, which nothing in a consumer's build would ever
report (§3.2). The rules live in StyleCop.Analyzers.Unstable; 1.2.0-beta of the main
package is a metapackage carrying no analyzer assembly. ADR-0016.
Every version of .Unstable is dash-free, so "latest" resolves within that line as usual.
